verdict.rationale: Canny documents native integrations explicitly aimed at support, sales, and chat sources (Gong, Intercom, Slack, Fathom, Fireflies) via Autopilot, plus a broader integrations directory and MCP access from chat-based AI tools, directly matching the PM's need to connect feedback capture to existing tools. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these integrations working in practice and more detail on setup/configuration beyond marketing copy.
